wpt._about: Live read on 2026-11-17 of the official Wynn WPT World Championship structures PDF (all 8 chunks). Every row below is matched to its own printed section by date, start time, buy-in and event name, and only the registration clause printed in that section is recorded. The fee split is recorded separately in WPT_SHEET_SECTIONS (scripts/data_venues.py) and transcribed in raw/wynn_wpt_world_championship_structures_2026-11-17.md.
